source_title: MEDKids Nerves starter card (demonstration data, unreviewed)
educational_content: Nerves are like tiny wires that carry messages. Nerves carry signals between the brain and the body. Nerves in the skin send messages about touch, heat and cold. The brain sends signals through nerves to tell muscles to move. The spinal cord is a big bundle of nerves inside the spine.
learning_objectives: Nerves carry signals between the brain and the body.
Nerves in the skin send messages about touch.
The brain uses nerves to tell muscles to move.

forbidden_claims.claim: We only use ten percent of our brain
